verdict.rationale: Factory's docs describe first-party Jira and Linear integrations. You can assign an issue to Factory or mention @Factory in a comment, and Droid will investigate, implement, and test the work. The CLI and App also stay synchronized with Jira, Linear, and other systems via MCP tools. Missing for 10: any evidence of ClickUp or Monday.com support (beyond generic MCP connectivity), explicit documentation of agents creating or updating ticket status and fields directly, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
